name: CAP-NZ Alerts
description: Ingests Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) alerts from a CAP-NZ RSS/Atom feed (e.g. MetService) and posts them to the map as polygon, circle, or point features with associated metadata.

permissions.description: Submits CAP alert features (polygons, circles, points) to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Polls the configured CAP-NZ RSS/Atom feed for new or updated alerts on a schedule.
